item.name: Find Available Entity Keys by Query

request.name: Find Available Entity Keys by Query

description.content:
Returns unique time series and/or attribute key names from entities matching the query.

Executes the Entity Data Query to find up to 100 entities, then fetches and aggregates all distinct key names.

Primarily used for UI features like autocomplete suggestions.

Available for users with 'TENANT_ADMIN' or 'CUSTOMER_USER' authority.

query.description:
(Required) When true, includes unique time series key names in the response.
When false, the 'timeseries' list will be empty.

(Required) When true, includes unique attribute key names in the response.
When false, the 'attribute' list will be empty. Use 'scope' parameter to filter by attribute scope.

Filters attribute keys by scope. Only applies when 'attributes' is true.
If not specified, returns attribute keys from all scopes.

response.name: OK

description.content: Returns the number of alarms that match the query definition.
